airspace.zh: 瑞士規定，幾乎所有無人機操作者都須在聯邦民航局（FOCA）的UAS.gate登記；在機場附近、自然保護區等地點飛行受到限制或須取得許可，部分州與鄉鎮另有限制。實際飛行前請先查詢FOCA無人機地圖與當地規定。
airspace.en: In Switzerland almost all drone operators must register with the Federal Office of Civil Aviation on UAS.gate; flying near airfields, in nature reserves and other areas is restricted or needs a permit, and some cantons and communes add their own limits. Check the FOCA drone map and local rules before any real flight.

joch.zh: 少女峰車站與斯芬克斯觀測站

tongue.note: Glacier snout above the Massa gorge; approximate

title.en: The Way to the Top of Europe

tagline.zh-Hant: 1811年首登少女峰、1912年鐵路通車、2001年世界遺產
tagline.en: First ascent in 1811, a railway in 1912, World Heritage in 2001

zh: 1811年，少女峰第一次被人登頂。
隔年，芬斯特拉峰也被登頂。
en: In 1811 the Jungfrau was climbed for the first time.
The Finsteraarhorn followed a year later.

zh: 艾格峰高3,967公尺，北壁是阿爾卑斯最難攀登的岩壁之一。
直到1938年，北壁才第一次被成功攀登。
en: The Eiger, 3,967 metres, has one of the hardest walls in the Alps on its north side.
The north face was not climbed until 1938.

zh: 1894年，實業家阿道夫·古耶－策勒取得鐵路特許。
他要把鐵路一路修到少女峰底下的鞍部。
en: In 1894 the industrialist Adolf Guyer-Zeller won a concession for a railway
to climb all the way to the saddle beneath the Jungfrau.

zh: 1896年開工，鐵路大部分在隧道裡，穿過艾格峰和僧侶峰。
隧道能避開風雪與嚴寒。
en: Work began in 1896. Most of the line runs in a tunnel through the Eiger and the Mönch,
sheltered from snow and cold.

zh: 1903年，艾格北壁車站啟用；1905年，冰海車站啟用。
乘客可以從岩壁上的窗口，看到外面的冰河。
en: Eigerwand station opened in 1903, Eismeer station in 1905.
Through windows in the rock, passengers looked out on the ice.

zh: 古耶－策勒在1899年去世，沒有看到鐵路完工。
工程又持續了十多年。
en: Guyer-Zeller died in 1899 and never saw it finished.
The work went on for more than a decade.

zh: 1912年，鐵路通到少女峰車站，前後花了十六年。
車站海拔3,454公尺，是歐洲最高的火車站。
en: In 1912, sixteen years after work began, the line reached the Jungfraujoch.
At 3,454 metres it is the highest railway station in Europe.

zh: 1937年，鞍部上方的斯芬克斯觀測站啟用。
科學家在這裡研究高空的大氣與天氣。
en: In 1937 the Sphinx Observatory opened above the saddle,
where scientists study the high atmosphere and weather.

zh: 1997年，年遊客首次超過五十萬人次。
2000年6月1日，單日紀錄達到8,148人。
en: In 1997 annual visitors passed half a million for the first time.
On 1 June 2000 a record 8,148 people came in a single day.

zh: 1960年，伯恩州開始保護勞特布魯嫩谷的上游。
保護山區，比世界遺產的登錄更早開始。
en: In 1960 the canton of Bern took the upper Lauterbrunnen valley under protection,
long before the World Heritage listing.

zh: 2001年，少女峰－阿萊奇列入世界遺產。
它是阿爾卑斯山的第一處世界自然遺產。
en: In 2001 Jungfrau-Aletsch joined the World Heritage List,
the first natural World Heritage site in the Alps.

zh: 2007年，範圍擴大到約824平方公里。
其中56%在瓦萊州，44%在伯恩州。
en: In 2007 it was enlarged to about 824 square kilometres,
56 per cent in Valais and 44 in Bern.

zh: 同一段時間，阿萊奇冰河持續後退。
1860年時，冰河比現在長三公里，冰面高出兩百公尺。
en: Through all those years the Aletsch kept retreating.
In 1860 it was 3 km longer, its surface 200 metres higher.

zh: 從第一次登頂、穿山的鐵路，到世界遺產，
人們用兩百年，走近了這片冰的國度。
en: From the first ascents and a railway through the mountain to World Heritage,
people have spent two centuries coming closer to this kingdom of ice.

title.en: Between the Valleys and the Peaks

tagline.zh-Hant: 歌德筆下的瀑布、山中的鐵路，與冰河旁的村莊
tagline.en: Goethe's waterfall, a railway in the mountain and villages beside the ice

zh: 勞特布魯嫩谷的施陶巴赫瀑布，從將近三百公尺高的崖頂落下。
水在半空中散成水霧。
en: Lauterbrunnen's Staubbach Falls drops from a cliff nearly 300 metres high,
breaking into spray in mid-air.

zh: 1779年，詩人歌德來到這裡。
這道瀑布啟發他寫下〈水上精靈之歌〉。
en: In 1779 the poet Goethe came here,
and the falls inspired his "Song of the Spirits over the Waters".

zh: 少女峰、僧侶峰和艾格峰，是瑞士最熟悉的山景之一。
三座山的名字，常被人一起提起。
en: Jungfrau, Mönch and Eiger make one of the most familiar views in Switzerland.
Their three names are often spoken together.

zh: 艾格北壁的攀登史，寫成了許多書和電影。
山下的村莊，用望遠鏡關注著每一次挑戰。
en: The story of the Eiger's north face has filled many books and films.
Villages below have followed each attempt through telescopes.

zh: 少女峰鐵路被宣傳為「歐洲之巔」。
火車在山體裡爬升，乘客從窗口看到冰河。
en: The Jungfrau Railway is billed as the way to the Top of Europe.
The train climbs inside the mountain; passengers glimpse glaciers through windows.

zh: 冰海車站海拔3,158公尺。
鐵路採用一公尺軌距，靠齒軌爬上陡坡。
en: Eismeer station lies at 3,158 metres.
The metre-gauge line climbs its steep grades on a rack.

zh: 格林德瓦是登山與旅遊的老鎮。
從十九世紀起，就有旅人來看冰河。
en: Grindelwald is an old town of climbers and travellers.
Visitors have come to see its glaciers since the 19th century.

zh: 當年的冰河伸到村莊附近。
今天，要走得更遠，才看得到冰。
en: Back then the glaciers reached close to the village.
Today you must go much further to see the ice.

zh: 阿萊奇冰河東側的森林，長在古老的冰磧上。
從樹林間，可以看到冰河留下的痕跡。
en: East of the glacier, the Aletsch Forest grows on old moraines,
and the traces left by the ice can be seen between the trees.

zh: 馬薩峽谷的河水被用來發電。
冰河融水，也是山谷居民的資源。
en: The water of the Massa gorge is used to make electricity.
Glacier melt is a resource for the valleys too.

zh: 梅耶倫湖靠近貝特默阿爾卑村，是健行路線上的景點。
步道沿著冰河邊緣延伸。
en: Märjelensee, near Bettmeralp, is a stop on the hiking trails
that run along the edge of the ice.

zh: 遺產區橫跨瓦萊州和伯恩州。
一邊說法語和德語的瓦萊，一邊是說德語的伯恩。
en: The site spans the cantons of Valais and Bern:
bilingual Valais on one side, German-speaking Bern on the other.

zh: 從歌德的詩、穿山的火車，到冰河邊的步道，
人們一直在這些山谷裡，找到與山相處的方式。
en: From Goethe's poem to a train through the mountain and trails beside the ice,
people have always found ways to live alongside these mountains.

tagline.zh-Hant: 阿萊奇森林、冰河湖、懸谷瀑布，與正在消失的冰
tagline.en: The Aletsch Forest, glacier lakes, hanging falls and vanishing ice

zh: 冰河後退，露出大片裸露的岩石與碎石。
植物從冰河邊緣開始，一步步長回來。
en: As the glacier retreats it lays bare wide stretches of rock and rubble.
Plants return step by step from the edge of the ice.

zh: 冰河東側的阿萊奇森林，長在冰磧上。
冰河在不同年代留下的堤岸，現在都覆蓋著樹。
en: The Aletsch Forest on the east side grows on moraines,
banks the ice left at different times, now covered in trees.

zh: 愈靠近冰河，樹愈年輕。
從樹齡，就能讀出冰河後退的速度。
en: The closer to the ice, the younger the trees.
Their ages record how fast the glacier has withdrawn.

zh: 冰面上的碎石帶，是兩條冰流交會留下的中磧。
它們像高速公路的分隔線，一路延伸到下游。
en: The rubble bands on the ice are medial moraines, left where ice streams merged.
Like lane markings, they run all the way downstream.

zh: 從正上方看，中磧把冰河分成幾條平行的帶子。
每一條帶子，來自上游不同的冰原。
en: From above, the medial moraines divide the glacier into parallel bands,
each coming from a different snowfield upstream.

zh: 梅耶倫湖海拔2,301公尺，緊鄰冰河。
冰河和湖，是相互影響的鄰居。
en: Märjelensee, at 2,301 metres, lies right beside the ice.
Glacier and lake are neighbours that shape each other.

zh: 冰河融水，在山裡匯成急流。
特呂默爾巴赫瀑布，就是冰河融水在岩石裡切出的水道。
en: Glacier melt gathers into torrents inside the mountain.
Trümmelbach Falls is a channel the meltwater has cut through the rock.

zh: 勞特布魯嫩谷的瀑布，從冰河留下的懸谷落下。
支流的谷底比主谷高，水只能直落而下。
en: Lauterbrunnen's waterfalls drop from hanging valleys the glaciers left.
The side valleys sit higher than the main one, so the water simply falls.

zh: 海拔四千公尺的山頂，終年積雪。
雪壓成冰，供給下方的冰河。
en: Summits at 4,000 metres hold snow all year.
Pressed into ice, it feeds the glaciers below.

zh: 斯芬克斯觀測站監測高山的空氣。
冰河的變化，也是氣候變化的紀錄。
en: The Sphinx Observatory monitors the mountain air.
The changing glaciers are a record of a changing climate.

zh: 格林德瓦的冰河，也退向山谷上方。
冰退去的地方，留下新的岩壁和碎石坡。
en: Grindelwald's glaciers are drawing back up their valleys,
leaving new rock walls and slopes of scree.

zh: 即使在後退，阿萊奇冰河在協和廣場仍有九百多公尺厚。
這裡的冰，要很多年才會流到冰河末端。
en: Even in retreat, the Aletsch is still over 900 metres thick at Konkordiaplatz.
Ice here takes many years to travel down to the tip.

zh: 冰河退去，森林跟著長上來；
這片山，正在我們眼前改變模樣。
en: The ice withdraws and the forest follows it up the valley;
these mountains are changing shape before our eyes.

title.en: The Largest Ice in the Alps

tagline.zh-Hant: 三萬五千公頃的冰河、四條冰流交會的協和廣場，與阿萊奇冰河
tagline.en: 35,000 ha of glaciers, the meeting of four ice streams, and the Aletsch

zh: 瑞士阿爾卑斯的少女峰－阿萊奇地區，有大片相連的冰河。
冰河面積約三萬五千公頃，是阿爾卑斯山最大的連續冰區。
en: The Jungfrau-Aletsch region of the Swiss Alps is a sheet of connected glaciers.
About 35,000 hectares of ice make it the largest continuous ice area in the Alps.

zh: 協和廣場是四條冰流交會的地方。
冰在這裡的厚度，量到過905公尺。
en: Konkordiaplatz is where four streams of ice meet.
The ice here has been measured at 905 metres thick.

zh: 從西北方來的是少女峰冰原，從北方來的是永雪原。
兩側的冰原，也一起匯入。
en: The Jungfraufirn comes in from the north-west, the Ewigschneefäld from the north,
and more firn joins from either side.

zh: 匯合後的冰流，就是阿萊奇冰河。
它長約二十三公里，是阿爾卑斯山最長的冰河。
en: Together they become the Aletsch Glacier,
about 23 kilometres long, the longest in the Alps.

zh: 冰河面積約82平方公里，冰量約15立方公里。
冰面上的深色條紋，是兩側岩壁落下的碎石。
en: It covers about 82 square kilometres and holds some 15 cubic kilometres of ice.
The dark stripes on its surface are rock fallen from the valley walls.

zh: 冰河的末端，融水匯成馬薩河。
河水穿過馬薩峽谷，最後在布里格附近流進隆河。
en: At the glacier's tip, meltwater gathers into the Massa.
It runs through the Massa gorge and joins the Rhône near Brig.

zh: 1870年以來，冰河已經後退了3.2公里。
1980年以後，就退了1.3公里。
en: Since 1870 the glacier has retreated 3.2 kilometres,
1.3 kilometres of it since 1980.

zh: 到2016年，冰層變薄了三百多公尺。
2006年一年，冰河末端就退了114.6公尺。
en: By 2016 the ice had thinned by more than 300 metres.
In 2006 alone the tip drew back 114.6 metres.

zh: 冰河東側的梅耶倫湖，位在海拔2,301公尺。
它是一座依偎在冰河邊的湖。
en: On the east side lies Märjelensee, at 2,301 metres,
a lake cradled at the edge of the ice.

zh: 芬斯特拉峰海拔4,270公尺，是這片遺產區的最高峰。
區內還有八座山峰超過四千公尺。
en: The Finsteraarhorn, 4,270 metres, is the highest summit of the site.
Eight more peaks here rise above 4,000 metres.

zh: 少女峰海拔4,158公尺。
它和僧侶峰、艾格峰，組成伯恩高地的天際線。
en: The Jungfrau stands 4,158 metres high.
With the Mönch and the Eiger it forms the skyline of the Bernese Oberland.

zh: 北邊的勞特布魯嫩谷，是冰河切出的U形谷。
陡峭的谷壁上，掛著一道道瀑布。
en: To the north, the Lauterbrunnen valley is a U-shaped trough cut by glaciers.
Waterfalls hang from its sheer walls.

zh: 特呂默爾巴赫瀑布藏在山體裡面。
它收集了艾格、僧侶與少女峰的融水。
en: Trümmelbach Falls is hidden inside the mountain,
carrying meltwater from the Eiger, Mönch and Jungfrau.

zh: 東北邊的格林德瓦，也有冰河伸向山谷。
這些冰河同樣在後退。
en: To the north-east, glaciers reach down towards Grindelwald.
They too are retreating.

zh: 四條冰流、二十三公里的冰河、一道道懸谷瀑布，
阿爾卑斯的地形，是冰河在數十萬年間雕出來的。
en: Four streams of ice, a 23-kilometre glacier, waterfalls in hanging valleys:
the Alps were carved by ice over hundreds of thousands of years.
